registration_timing: Registered after the fresh-100 confirmatory assessment and before resilient-pair implementation validation.

motivation.observed_failure: One of 800 confirmatory FACETS/Python JMLE attempt units returned FACETS exit 0 without a U6 report, although the Python JMLE had already completed inside the legacy pair function.
motivation.diagnostic: Three isolated serial replays succeeded and passed direct agreement, supporting a transient report-I/O classification without proving concurrency as the cause.
motivation.identity_gap: The v1 study identity bound the top-level execution script but did not bind imported estimation/parser modules or the FACETS executable binary.

scope: A versioned repository-only resilient FACETS/Python pair component and fault-injection pilot. The frozen confirmatory v1 runner and evidence are immutable.

contracts.python_first: Fit and completion-mark the Python JMLE artifact before any FACETS attempt.
contracts.evidence_separation: Python statistical readiness is independent of FACETS calibration readiness. A FACETS failure cannot erase a completed Python artifact.

facets_retry.eligible_only_when: The legacy pair raises a FACETS primary/auxiliary failure with exit=0 and the corresponding report is absent.
facets_retry.retention: Every try directory, stdout, stderr, specification, and outcome JSON is retained.

contracts.serialization: A cross-process file lock serializes the legacy pair call. Because the legacy function couples Python and FACETS, this v2 component conservatively locks the repeated pair call; a later low-level split may narrow the lock to FACETS only.
contracts.python_replay: When FACETS succeeds, the Python estimates recomputed inside the legacy pair must match the independently persisted Python artifact within 1e-12.
contracts.full_qualification: Requires both independent Python readiness and FACETS/Python direct-agreement readiness. StatisticalEvidenceReady and CalibrationReady remain separate fields.
contracts.dependency_identity: Bind all repository mfrm_app Python modules, streamlit_app.py, direct validation dependencies, requirements files, the resilient component, and the FACETS executable SHA-256/version.

validation_scenarios.injection: First pair call raises exit-0/missing-report; second call uses real FACETS 4.5.0.
validation_scenarios.expected: Python completion exists before FACETS; two tries; final calibration pass; first failure retained.

validation_scenarios.injection: All three pair calls raise exit-0/missing-report.
validation_scenarios.expected: Python statistical artifact remains ready; calibration false; full qualification false; three failures retained.

validation_scenarios.injection: First pair call raises a nonzero-exit failure.
validation_scenarios.expected: No retry; Python remains ready; calibration false.

validation_scenarios.injection: Concurrent workers target the same lock.
validation_scenarios.expected: At most one worker is inside the protected pair scope at a time.

prohibitions: Do not modify validation/estimand_distribution_study.py or its confirmatory artifacts.
Do not use retry output to replace confirmatory attempt 01024 or raise H6 from 99 to 100 pairs.
Do not retry statistical/numerical failures until success.
Do not rank JMLE, MML, and CMLE or compare likelihoods across bases.
promotion_gate: The component may inform a future H6-only runner only after all four validation scenarios pass, dependency identity is verified, and a separate fresh-replicate execution plan is registered.
